# JPMorgan and Bank of America 2024 Annual Financial Comparison

**Insufficient evidence**

JPM revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $177.556 billion [E3b5c412b70](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html), up from $158.104 billion for 2023-12-31 [E037f4f822d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961724000225/0000019617-24-000225-index.html). JPM net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $58.471 billion [E73e8d7838d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html), up from $49.552 billion for 2023-12-31 [E9f5a5d270c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961724000225/0000019617-24-000225-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of March 1, 2023, known-then filings for Bank of America included qualitative statements concerning risk management models, Value at Risk expectations [E776e4694a5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [Eda6e70a30c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm), tax assets [Ed319e058f0](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm), funding risk [E8d10d5281c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm), and plans to disclose financed emissions reductions [Efc7c617a1c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000131/bac-20220930.htm) [E97d2c55501](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000112/bac-20220630.htm). Operating income and capex metrics lacked supported annual USD XBRL tags under the retrieved disclosures [E520eca78d5] [Ece97180a89].

## What happened later

For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, JPMorgan reported annual revenue of $177,556,000,000 [E3b5c412b70](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html) and net income of $58,471,000,000 [E73e8d7838d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html). Bank of America reported annual revenue of $101,887,000,000 [E5b63bf2d22](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html) and net income of $27,132,000,000 [E174803488b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html). Operating income and capex metrics remain unavailable due to a coverage gap [E5498d85d67] [E68c725b7c3].

## The peer test

Comparing the latest annual periods through December 31, 2024, JPMorgan achieved higher revenue ($177,556,000,000 for the period ending 2024-12-31) [E3b5c412b70](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html) compared to Bank of America ($101,887,000,000 for the period ending 2024-12-31) [E5b63bf2d22](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html). Similarly, JPMorgan reported net income of $58,471,000,000 [E73e8d7838d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/19617/000001961725000270/0000019617-25-000270-index.html), while Bank of America reported net income of $27,132,000,000 [E174803488b](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085825000139/0000070858-25-000139-index.html) for their respective 2024 fiscal year-ends. Both institutions share a standard calendar fiscal year ending on 2024-12-31.

## Cross-examination

The retrieved management claims for Bank of America consist of qualitative goals, risk models, and emissions targets rather than measurable financial guidance [E776e4694a5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085823000092/bac-20221231.htm) [Efc7c617a1c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085822000131/bac-20220930.htm). Because no explicit quantitative financial forecasts or matching capex/operating income tags were retrieved, the qualitative outlook passages cannot be verified against subsequent financial outcomes [E5498d85d67] [E68c725b7c3].

## Limits

- Operating income and capex metrics lack supported XBRL tags for both JPM and BAC, resulting in source coverage gaps.
- Retrieved management expectations focus on qualitative disclosures, emissions goals, and risk models instead of explicit financial guidance.
